catalogue_notes: GUI tools are .net 10 only, except TimeApp, which is also built for .net 4.
CLI tools are built for both .net 4.7.2 and .net 10, except AmcacheParser, SQLECmd, VSCMount and WxTCmd, which are .net 10 only.
.net 4 software requires at least .NET Framework 4.7.2 (TimeApp: 4.8). .net 10 software requires the .NET 10 runtime; GUI programs need the Desktop runtime.
All software is digitally signed (observed leaf signer on 2026-10 builds: 'ZimTech LLC', Sectigo Public Code Signing CA R36 chain).
